verdict.rationale: Vapi is a voice AI platform that processes user call data, so a training opt-out is a fair question for it. The evidence documents HIPAA compliance mode, approved-provider restrictions and recording/log storage controls. None of these is a documented control that stops customer data from being used to train AI models, so they are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
